gloss: to raise, to hold up; to advocate

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {掲|かか}げていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to raise, to hold up, to hoist
definitions.explanation: To lift something up high so it can be seen — a flag, a sign, a banner, or a light.

definitions.gloss: to advocate, to put forward, to espouse
definitions.explanation: To publicly declare a goal, ideal, policy, or slogan. Used when a person or organization prominently promotes a principle or objective.

definitions.gloss: to publish, to post, to list
definitions.explanation: To display or publish information in a visible place — a notice, an article, or a list.

examples.japanese: デモ{隊|たい}はプラカードを{高|たか}く{掲|かか}げて{行進|こうしん}した。
examples.english: The demonstrators marched holding placards high.

examples.japanese: {松明|たいまつ}を{掲|かか}げて{暗|くら}い{道|みち}を{進|すす}んだ。
examples.english: They held up torches and advanced along the dark path.

examples.japanese: {平和|へいわ}を{目標|もくひょう}に{掲|かか}げる。
examples.english: To advocate peace as a goal.

examples.japanese: {会社|かいしゃ}は「{環境|かんきょう}に{優|やさ}しい」をスローガンに{掲|かか}げている。
examples.english: The company espouses "eco-friendly" as its slogan.

examples.japanese: {改革|かいかく}を{掲|かか}げて{選挙|せんきょ}に{立候補|りっこうほ}した。
examples.english: He ran for election advocating reform.

examples.japanese: {新聞|しんぶん}に{記事|きじ}が{掲|かか}げられた。
examples.english: An article was published in the newspaper.

examples.japanese: {掲示板|けいじばん}にお{知|し}らせを{掲|かか}げた。
examples.english: A notice was posted on the bulletin board.

examples.japanese: {以下|いか}に{掲|かか}げる{条件|じょうけん}を{満|み}たす{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: You must meet the conditions listed below.

notes:
{掲|かか}げる has three related meanings that all involve making something visible or prominent — physically raising something, publicly declaring principles, or publishing information.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜を{掲|かか}げる: to raise ~, to advocate ~, to post ~
- 〜を{目標|もくひょう}に{掲|かか}げる: to put forward ~ as a goal
- 〜をスローガンに{掲|かか}げる: to adopt ~ as a slogan

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {旗|はた}を{掲|かか}げる: to raise a flag
- {理念|りねん}を{掲|かか}げる: to espouse a principle
- {目標|もくひょう}を{掲|かか}げる: to set forth a goal
- {方針|ほうしん}を{掲|かか}げる: to put forward a policy
